summary: Wired a Pi extension UI store through the agent server, websocket transport, and frontend client interfaces, then plumbed the store into App.svelte, AppDialogs, Conversation, and Titlebar with corresponding Svelte components and CSS.
decisions: Switched session.bindExtensions mode from 'json' to 'rpc' and passed uiContext so extensions can request UI interactions
Added an 'extension.ui.respond' websocket message and matching resolveExtensionUi method on AgentClient/WebSocketAgentClient to forward user responses back to extensions
Used a manual reverse-loop lastString helper instead of Array.prototype.findLast to keep TS target library compatibility
Made Titlebar's extensionUi prop optional and default piStatuses to an empty array so the existing Titlebar test continues to compile
dialogFor falls back to the first dialog when no sessionId is supplied, to support startup/background dialogs
errors: tsc failed on pi-extension-ui-runtime.ts because findLast isn't available in the configured lib target and dialog overloads returned string|boolean instead of string; resolved by replacing findLast with a reverse-loop lastString and adding typed dialog wrappers
svelte-check failed on Titlebar.test.ts after adding a required extensionUi prop; resolved by making the prop optional and guarding the derived statuses list
Edit on App.svelte failed due to a non-unique match for the Titlebar props block; resolved by providing more surrounding context
